title: Machines and Language Theory
objectives:
A presentation of the theory of computing, including coverage of the theory of formal languages
and automata, compatibility, computational complexity, and deterministic parsing of context-free
languages.
textbooks:
1. Sipser. Introduction to the Theory of Computation. PWS Publishing company, 1997.
2. Linz, An Introduction to Formal Languages and Automata. 3rd edition ed., Jone,s and Bartlett
Publishers, 2001.
